_note: Every pre-written line in the escape (docs/Game Design.md sections 8-10). Voice files: assets/voice/escape/<id>.mp3, made by tools/record_escape_lines.py. 'who' is aaron, dhan or marvis.

aftershock_dhan.text: [groans in pain] Agh! My leg... it's stuck under the locker.

aftershock_aaron.text: Don't move. Johnny, I'll lift. You pull him out.

lift_ready.text: Got it! Pull him out, quick!

lift_drop.text: Can't hold it... sorry. Tell me when you're ready.

freed_dhan.text: Thanks. I can't walk on this leg.

freed_context_aaron.text: This ship is breaking apart. The escape shuttle in the shuttle bay is our way home. Let's ask M.A.R.V.I.S. what still works.

beat2_problem_dhan.text: Okay. The shuttle's fine, but the clamps holding it in the bay have no power. We need to power them.

beat2_dhan.text: One way: fix the power in engineering. It's probably a blown fuse. I can't get there, but I can talk you through it on the radio.

beat2_aaron.text: Other way: take the lab's emergency battery to the shuttle bay. But that battery keeps the freezer cold, and Kien's and my samples are in it.

beat2_dhan_call.text: Your call, Captain. Engineering, or the lab.

enter_eng_dhan.text: You in engineering? Tell me what you see.

wrong_switch_dhan.text: Not that one. Okay, okay. Try again.

eng_power_dhan.text: Hear that hum? The shuttle bay has power again. You did it, Captain.

enter_lab_aaron.text: The freezer is still on. The samples are still cold.

freezer_question.text: Do we really have to turn the freezer off?

case_delivered.text: Case is here, by the freezer. Only one rack fits.

lift_count_drop.text: Ow. Okay. Again. Lift on three.

lift_count_done.text: Got it. Now push the cart to the shuttle bay.

enter_medbay_aaron.text: Splints are in that cabinet. Vials too. Read me the labels before you give him anything.

splint_dhan.text: Oh, that's much better. Thank you.

galley_aaron.text: Kien was so excited about real food.

stage2_aaron.text: He needs something for the pain. And that leg shouldn't move.

stage3_aaron.text: Johnny. He's going pale. We need to move.

stage4_aaron.text: Stay with us, Dhan. Stay awake.

stage3_dhan_question.text: Hey, Captain. If this goes bad... don't wait for me.

switch_offer_aaron.text: Johnny... we could still use the battery.

bay_powered_dhan.text: The shuttle bay has power. Get me on that shuttle.

carry_dhan.text: Careful with the leg. Careful... ow.

aaron_needs_pilot.text: Get in the pilot seat first. If the clamps open with no one flying, the shuttle drifts away.

aaron_dhan_first.text: Dhan first. Let's get him aboard.

aaron_releasing.text: Releasing the clamps. Don't you dare leave without me.

nudge_free_dhan_1.text: I can lift it. I just need you to pull him.

nudge_free_dhan_2.text: Johnny. Tell me to lift, then grab Dhan.

nudge_marvis_1.text: Ask M.A.R.V.I.S. what's broken. Use the junction terminal, or the radio.

nudge_marvis_2.text: Junction terminal, or radio M.A.R.V.I.S. Ask it for a status report.

nudge_choose_1.text: Engineering's north of the junction. The lab's south. Either way, the clamps need power.

nudge_choose_2.text: Dhan can talk you through the cabinet. Or we take the lab battery.

nudge_eng_isolate_1.text: Tell me what you see in there. Is anything sparking?

nudge_eng_isolate_2.text: There's a big handle by the door. It cuts the power. Pull it before you touch anything.

nudge_eng_code_1.text: That cabinet display should be showing a fault code.

nudge_eng_code_2.text: Read me the code on the cabinet. I know them all.

nudge_eng_fuse_1.text: The spares are in Storage, past the galley.

nudge_eng_fuse_2.text: Tell me the code and I'll tell you the box.

nudge_eng_test_1.text: New fuse in? Then test it.

nudge_eng_toggle_1.text: It tripped? The display shows which switch is shorting.

nudge_eng_toggle_2.text: Read me the AUX number on the display. I wired those switches.

breaker_dhan.text: Switch is cut. Last step: RESTART only works if the shuttle bay breaker is held shut at the same time. You can't be in both places. Send Aaron to the bay power panel.

breaker_ready_aaron.text: I'm at the bay breaker. Go to the cabinet and tell me 'now'. I can only hold it a few seconds.

breaker_let_go_aaron.text: Had to let go. Say 'now' again when you're at the cabinet.

fumble_cabinet_aaron.text: I don't know this panel, Johnny. Dhan does. Radio him before you touch anything else.

fumble_fuse_aaron.text: Which one do we need? I have no idea. Read Dhan the code on the cabinet. He'll know.

fumble_toggle_aaron.text: Stop guessing, Johnny. Dhan wired these switches. Read him the AUX number.

fumble_socket_aaron.text: I don't know which setting is right. Dhan knows this battery. Ask him before you connect it.

fumble_freezer_dhan.text: Wait, is that the lab freezer? Talk to Aaron first. Those are his samples.

nudge_eng_breaker_1.text: RESTART needs two people. Send Aaron to the shuttle bay breaker.

nudge_eng_breaker_2.text: Radio Aaron. Tell him to hold the bay breaker.

nudge_eng_restart_1.text: Aaron's on the breaker. Tell him 'now', then press RESTART.

nudge_eng_restart_2.text: Say 'now' to Aaron, then hit RESTART.

nudge_bat_freezer_1.text: The battery won't come out while the freezer is using it.

nudge_bat_freezer_2.text: The freezer has to go off first. I know.

nudge_bat_latch_1.text: The latch is on the battery itself.

nudge_bat_latch_2.text: Hold the latch on the battery to release it.

nudge_bat_lift_1.text: That's too heavy for one person.

nudge_bat_lift_2.text: Ask me. I'll take the other side.

nudge_bat_cart_1.text: The emergency socket's in the bay, across from the shuttle.

nudge_bat_cart_2.text: Take the cart to the bay's emergency socket.

nudge_bat_socket_1.text: That socket's got a selector. The wrong setting just pops the breaker.

nudge_bat_socket_2.text: Ask me which setting. I know that battery.

nudge_carry_1.text: The shuttle bay has power. Now we get Dhan on the shuttle.

nudge_carry_2.text: Ask me to help carry Dhan. He can't walk it alone.

nudge_seat_1.text: Someone has to fly this thing, Captain.

nudge_seat_2.text: Pilot seat. Then tell me to release the clamps.

nudge_release_1.text: I'll work the clamps from the console here. Tell me to release them.

nudge_release_2.text: Tell me to release the clamps. Then fire the thrusters and give me the word.

clamps_ready_aaron.text: I'm at the clamp console. Hit HOLD THRUSTERS on your panel, then tell me 'release'.

thrust_out_aaron.text: Thrusters cut out. Fire them again, then tell me 'release'.

vial_right_dhan.text: Oh... that's better. The pain's going. Thanks, Captain.

vial_wrong_dhan.text: [gasps] That's not a painkiller. My heart's pounding.

fumble_vial_dhan.text: Do you know what's in those? I don't. Aaron knows medicine. Read him the labels.

nudge_release_mark_1.text: I'm at the console. Hold thrusters first, then give me the word.

marvis.unknown: Query not recognized. Available: STATUS. POWER. SHUTTLE. CREW. MEDICAL. DOORS.
marvis.unavailable: Function unavailable. I am a maintenance system.
marvis.main_engineering: Main power: restored to the shuttle bay.
marvis.main_battery: Main power: offline. Shuttle bay: emergency battery.
marvis.manual_release: Clamps must be released at the shuttle bay console.
marvis.cabinet_isolated: Engineering cabinet: power cut. Safe to work on.
marvis.battery_bay: Emergency battery: connected to shuttle bay.
marvis.crew_kien: Crew member KIEN: no signal since impact.
marvis.dhan_recommend: Recommended: splint the leg. Painkillers: medbay cabinet.
marvis.dhan_no_vitals: Crew member DHAN: no vital signs.
marvis.codes_unavailable: Fault code reference unavailable. Consult engineering crew.
marvis.docking_available: Docking clamps: powered. Release them at the shuttle bay console.
